walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA GCSE Geography specification.

Contrasts in World Development appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Contrasts in World Development in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Contrasts in World Development.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
